name: handoff
description: /handoff summarizes the session into a prompt a fresh session can pick up; --new continues it in a fresh session; --save stores it; --each stores one per suggested plan; --list and --resume <id> revisit stored handoffs

writer.title: Recap writer
writer.description: Who writes the recap. haiku (the default) asks Haiku in the background; when the API refuses, a subagent writes it. subagent skips Haiku and starts the subagent at once, for an API proxy that refuses background requests. conversation has the session's own model write the recap as a normal turn.
